title: How the Week Looks
intro: Worked out from your records when this page loads. Sydney time. This week is {{week}}.
couldntRead: Couldn't read this just now. Nothing is guessed.
attentionDef: Owner decisions, clarifications, your waiting workflows, your previews, failed actions and outcomes to record, for your role.
noTimetable: The lesson timetable isn't set up in this database.
noLessonsToday: No lessons on the timetable today.
allStarted: All of today's lessons have started or finished.
lessonsDef: Scheduled or taught lessons starting today. Cancelled lessons aren't counted.
noAvailability: No tutor availability is recorded for today, so this can't be worked out.
noneAway: No tutors recorded as away today.
tutorsDef: Tutors with at least one free slot today who aren't recorded as away.
noCapacity: No tutor availability is recorded for this week or next week.
bookedNextWeek: {{booked}} of {{offered}} offered hours are booked next week ({{range}}). Nothing is offered this week yet.
capacityDef: Booked hours divided by all offered hours (booked plus free) in the tutor calendar, Monday to Sunday. If nothing is offered this week yet, next week is shown and labelled. Free time on a day a tutor is away isn't offered.
eachDay: Each day {{when}}, from the tutor calendar.
notEnough: Not enough data: no tutor availability is recorded for this week or next week.
byDayCaption: Booked and free hours by day, {{when}}
mixHint: Saved in the last 30 days ({{range}}), by the colour the rules gave them.
noNew: No new requests in the last 30 days.
mixDef: A count of rule results, not a measure of time saved.
byStepHint: What happens next on each open request, for your role.
actOverview: Act on these in the Overview
coverageCardText: How many requests the owner's rules handled, common reasons for yellow, suggested rule changes and what is connected are on the Coverage page.
foot: Figures come from the records in this database. Later days this week show what is already booked or offered.
